integrity.euler_basis: Compactly supported Euler characteristic localizes to the fixed locus for algebraic C-star actions; projectivity identifies it with ordinary Euler characteristic on the closed levels.
integrity.first_public_date_basis: The arXiv record for 1303.6661 gives first submission date 2013-03-26.
integrity.fixed_locus_basis: A generic diagonal conjugation cocharacter fixes the diagonal projective subspace and the off-diagonal matrix-unit points, and no other ambient projective points.
integrity.maximal_coincidence_basis: Every such fixed point has common spectral multiplicity exactly n-1 with its cutoff.
integrity.object_basis: The primary papers define the exact and closed eigenvalue-coincidence varieties for a matrix and its upper-left cutoff.
integrity.primary_slot_basis: The published article lists MSC 14M15 first, followed by 14L30 and 20G20.

scientific_limitations: The theorem computes Euler characteristic only; it does not determine Betti numbers, intersection cohomology, singularities, or component incidence.
The proof uses the upper-left-cutoff eigenvalue-coincidence problem and its diagonal-conjugation symmetry.
The fixed-point argument is short, so an unindexed or folklore observation remains possible.
title: Euler characteristic of projectivized eigenvalue-coincidence filtrations
